name: EaselJS
role: Legacy Canvas display list from the CreateJS suite; pre-dates modern Canvas scene graphs
summary: Canvas 2D display-list library (Stage, Container, Bitmap, Shape, Text) modelled on the Flash API, part of CreateJS and designed to pair with TweenJS. Driven by a Ticker; output is Canvas frames. A limited StageGL (WebGL) mode exists. The last npm release is 1.0.2 from 2017; the repository still gets sporadic commits, so treat it as legacy and mainly relevant for existing CreateJS or Adobe Animate exports.
use_when: Rendering existing CreateJS or Adobe Animate canvas exports
Flash-style display list paired with TweenJS in an existing codebase
avoid_when: New scenes needing a scene graph: Konva for Canvas, PixiJS for GPU
Maintained tweening and timelines: GSAP over TweenJS
Anything needing modern TypeScript types or ESM: Konva or Fabric.js
notes: 2026-10-26: createjs.com/easeljs returned only a stub page; the repository on GitHub (CreateJS/EaselJS) is a likelier official_url. Last npm release date comes from the registry; the Jan 2026 commit was a minor touch-input fix.

assessment.rationale: No npm release since 2017-09-18 (1.0.2); repo's latest commit is a minor touch fix on 2026-01-24. Konva covers Canvas scene graphs and PixiJS the GPU case, so incremental value is limited to legacy CreateJS content.
